## Video Forge: developer view

Windows desktop app for deterministic, narrated, subtitled, character-driven video.
Bring-your-own-keys for TTS, LLMs and stock media; rendering is local.

### Stack

- **Shell:** Electron 45, built with `electron-vite`, packaged with `electron-builder` (NSIS installer + portable exe, `asar: false`). Package version `0.4.0-beta.1`.
- **UI:** React 19, Tailwind 4, Zustand stores, Vite 8, TypeScript 7.
- **Render:** Remotion 4.0.540 plus a HyperFrames page builder (`electron/render/hyperframes/`); FFmpeg for encode, mux and post.
- **3D:** three.js 0.170 with Kenney CC0 models (`characters/samples/kenney/builder/models/{mini,pets,props}`).
- **No browser mode:** the app runs only in its own window; there is no local HTTP port.

### Pipeline

1. **Script → segments.** `Name: text` lines (`src/lib/narration/parseScript.ts`); names matched case-insensitively against speaker labels and aliases. Also `Name [direction]: text` stage directions, `[SFX: stem]` cue lines, in-line move tags and `[pop …]` / emoji pop-ups.
2. **TTS per segment.** Engines: `gemini`, `fish` (via OpenRouter), `elevenlabs`, `piper`, and `dramabox` (external, rented GPU, not synthesised in-app). A Greek tonos fixer and the user's pronunciation list run before synthesis. Gemini lines are re-checked against the script and remade on drift.
3. **Timing.** Per-segment start and end from the audio; word times spread by word length and re-anchored at measured pauses (`src/lib/subtitles/wordTiming.ts`). Exact word times are used when an engine supplies them.
4. **Tracks.** Visemes (9 shapes plus in-betweens 10–12, ~100 ms hold), brows and head from punctuation, gestures, move tracks, pops, staging and camera directions.
5. **Render** in `renderVideo` (in-app, Many videos and `--job` share it), then **post**: the audio graph runs before the frames, the optional grade after.

### Post-production (`electron/post`)

- Settings and presets: `src/lib/post/postSettings.ts`; pure filter graphs: `electron/post/postGraph.ts`; runner: `electron/post/runPost.ts`.
- **Studio sound:** high-pass 80 Hz, gentle compressor, light de-ess, two-pass `loudnorm` to −14 LUFS / −1 dBTP. Narration only; music and effects are mixed after.
- **Voice characters** per speaker: natural, chibi, bright, warm, deep, radio, plus pitch (±4 st), brightness, sparkle. Formant shift needs Rubber Band; without it pitch falls back to `asetrate` + `atempo`.
- **Stereo:** pan from each speaker's x (or set seat), far side down by at most 30% (`MAX_PAN`). Off with one speaker.
- **Grade:** user `.cube` via `lut3d` + `eq` contrast and saturation; path-guarded; one extra encode.
- **FFmpeg choice** (`electron/process/ffmpegChoice.ts`): installer's own (gyan.dev 9.0.2 essentials, pinned with SHA-256 in `tools/lib/ffmpegBundle.mjs`) → full one on PATH → Remotion's bundled copy. Missing filters are warned about and skipped.

### Keys and data

- Vault: `%APPDATA%\video-forge\byok.secrets.enc`, Electron `safeStorage`; atomic saves, a `.bak` copy, and it never overwrites a vault it cannot read. Keys stay in the main process.
- Shared with Image Forge: `%APPDATA%\Forge\shared-keys.bin`, Windows DPAPI via PowerShell; newest write wins. Off Windows: no sharing.
- Providers: Gemini (extra keys rotated on quota), OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Groq, Cerebras, OpenAI, Mistral, any OpenAI-compatible server (`custom-url` + key), Pixabay, Pexels, Freesound (CC0 only), ElevenLabs (cost prompt, batch opt-in, per-sheet character cap).
- Update check: GitHub Releases API at most once a day (`update-check.json`); link only.
- Projects are JSON (`PLAIN_FIELDS` shared by the file and the autosave). Every file a render names passes the path guard (`electron/render/jobSafety.ts`).

### Batch (Many videos)

- A Google Sheet link (converted to its CSV export) or a CSV file. Header names lower-cased, with aliases: `name, script, topic, template, format, music, backgrounds, language` (`src/store/useManyStore.ts`). Only `script` is required.
- One run at a time; each row becomes a job rendered through the same path; output folder `<sheet> · <date> · <n> videos`.

### Builds

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm ci` | Install exact versions |
| `npm run dev` | electron-vite dev with watch |
| `npm test` | Node's built-in test runner over `tools/lib/*.test.mjs`, explainer and character tests |
| `npm run ffmpeg` | Fetch, checksum and unpack the pinned FFmpeg to `build/ffmpeg/` |
| `npm run build-exe:public` | Public installer + portable exe in `release\` |
| `npm run build-exe` | Personal build when personal content is present |
| `npm run build-exe:check` | Dry run with electron-builder's file rules |
| `npm run personal` | Owner only: clone the private content repo beside the app and junction it in |
| `npm run brand -- <name>` | Switch a brand pack on (`brand.local.json`); `off` for neutral |
| `npm run docs:move-tags` | Regenerate `docs/MOVE-TAGS.md` from the motion library |

- **Public vs Personal:** the guard (`tools/lib/buildKind.mjs`) refuses `models/animated/` and `motions.json` (Mixamo-derived, not redistributable) in Public. Personal has its own appId and shares userData.
- **Release:** `release.yml` on a `v*` tag checks tag = `package.json` version, that `release-notes/v<version>.md` and a CHANGELOG entry exist, runs `npm test` and `tsc --noEmit`, fetches FFmpeg, builds Public and publishes (a pre-release when the tag has `-`). The same tag runs `deploy-docs.yml` for this site.
- **Env vars** (all optional, see `.env.example`): `VIDEOFORGE_USER_DATA`, `VIDEOFORGE_RENDER_CPU`, `VIDEOFORGE_CARD_SATURATION`, `HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH`, `VIDEOFORGE_SECRETS_DIR`.
- **Not signed:** no Authenticode signature yet; SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC".
